Description:
Hi,

In one of my project I am using mysql db v8.0.35 where we faced index corruption issue. Our most recent backup file was also not worked because of same. I want to understand is this condition raised in case of disabling SQL_SAFE_UPDATES feature. while some query execution our developer has disabled it as it was not allowed some bulk delete operation.

How to repeat:
Its random & we have faced this first time so don't know the steps to reproduce it.

Hi,

You need to explain the problem in more details. Index corruption on InnoDB tables in 99% cases happens because of faulty hardware.

Furthermore, you are using rather old release, please upgrade to .40 and see if that helps.

Thank you for using MySQL Server

No feedback was provided for this bug for over a month, so it is
being suspended automatically. If you are able to provide the
information that was originally requested, please do so and change
the status of the bug back to "Open".
